top_band: snow-covered roof top surface on rows 1-8, and elliptical well rim/opening on rows 16-23
evidence: The well roof shows an 8-row foreshortened snow top (rows 1-8) with a bright edge (row 6) and shaded overhang/icicles (rows 8-10). Below, the well basin clearly shows a 3/4 elliptical opening (rows 17-22, 6 rows deep inside the rim) above an 8-row stone masonry front face (rows 23-30).

style.evidence: Compared to the reference roofed well next to it, the candidate is much flatter and more schematic: the stone base is a regular mechanical brick grid in only 2-3 flat grey tones (versus the reference's individually shaded multi-tone stones), the wooden posts and bucket lack rich value ramps, and the well opening is a flat dark fill.
